w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "TONIGHT: Small Claims. Alien judges settle village disputes. The gavel is a meteorite. Justice is swift, final, and deeply confused by property law."

w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 3 raiders (The Terms of Service, Loud-Eyes, Spool) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: You read its weight, its breath, the set of its shoulders. It's winding up Rerun — lands next beat. (Read Stance — pattern known.)
firstContext: It staggers — pain gets noticed. Its attention fixes on Adaeze.
You read its weight, its breath, the set of its shoulders. It's winding up Rerun — lands next beat. (Read Stance — pattern known.)
You focus — that costs your action.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 🗣️ Ramiro to Ursula, by the fire: "The granary wants food that WAITS — 990 of 2,000 kcal preserved. Smoke it, dry it, render it. The fresh stuff doesn't count."
Riders on the ridge — no, a cart. A TRADER. Word travels: Haven has food, and where there's food there's trade.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
⚠ WARNING: reserves critical. Eat tomorrow or the spiral begins.

noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."

loss.line: Haven couldn't hold. On the third hungry day, people started walking — in different directions. The scattering, again.

withdrawal.line: ◈ THE TABLE — the ring of pale light flickers at the edge of the sky... and does not come. The System does not apologize this time. "WE PRICED THE RUN. NO HUNGER ON THE RECORD — THE PELLET HUMS WHERE THE FIRE SHOULD BE. NO FEAST, NO SURGE, NOTHING HERE WE CAN PRICE. A COLD SPOT AT EVERY TABLE: THE WORDS WERE ON THE WRAPPER." The ledger still wants: the food-thesis deeds (no feast can carry the surge while the pellet hums). The mantle may pass to hungrier hands; the table will still be here.
